Tentu, ini dia tulisan latin dari Surat An-Nisa ayat 91-100:

**Surat An-Nisa Ayat 91-100 (Tulisan Latin)**

91. **Sa-yaj'alunal-laka wajhan wa yu'adduna minkum amana-ta-kum, fa-man lam yajid fa-shiyamu yau-ma-in itsnaani yauma-in ilaaha illa-llah. Qad sami'a-llahu ma qul-tum, fa-lam yal-tafita ilayhi illa-llahu ila-llah. Qad sami'a-llahu ma qul-tum, fa-lam yal-tafita ilayhi illa-llahu.**

92. **Wa ma kana li-mu'minin an yaqtula mu'minan illa khata'an, wa man qatala mu'minan khata'an fa-tahri-ru raqaba-tin mu'mina-tin wa diyata-n musallama-tan ila ahlihi illa an yash-shaddqu, fa-in kana min qaumin 'aduvvin lakum wa huwa mu'minun fa-tahri-ru raqaba-tin mu'mina-tin, wa in kana min qaumin baina-kum wa baina-hum miitsaaqun fa-diyatu-n musallama-tun ila ahlihi wa tahri-ru raqaba-tin mu'mina-tin, fa-man lam yajid fa-shiya-mu shathraini mutataabi'ai-ni tawba-tan minallahi, wa kaana-llahu 'aliiman hakiiman.**

93. **Wa man yaqtul mu'minan muta'am-midan fa-jaza'u-hu jahannamu khaalidan fii-ha wa ghadiba-llahu 'alayhi wa la'ana-hu wa a'adda lahu 'adzaaban 'aziiman.**

94. **Ya ayyuhal-ladziina aamanuu idzaa darabtum fii sabii-lillahi fa-tabayyanuu, wa laa taquuluu li-man alqaa ilaykumu-s-salaama lasta mu'minan, tabtaghuuna 'ara-dha-l-hayati-d-dunyaa, fa-'inda-llahi maghaa-nimu katsiira-tun, kadzaalika kuntum min qablu fa-manna-llahu 'alaykum, fa-tabayyanuu, innallaha kaana bimaa ta'maluuna khabiiran.**

95. **La yastawil-qa'iduuna min al-mu'miniina ghayru ulid-darari wa-l-mujaahiduuna fii sabii-lillahi bi-amwaali-him wa anfusihim, fadhalal-lahu-l-mujaahidiina bi-amwaali-him wa anfusihim 'alaa-l-qa'idiina daraja-tan, wa kulla-n wa'adal-lahu-l-husnaa, wa fadhalal-lahu-l-mujaahidiina 'alaa-l-qa'idiina ajran 'aziiman.**

96. **Daraajaati-n minhu wa maghfirata-n wa rahma-tan, wa kaana-llahu ghafuur-an rahiiman.**

97. **Innalladziina tawaffaa-humul-malaa'ikatu zhaalimi anfusihim qaluu-u-u-na fii-naa, qaluu bal kuntu-m ta'maluuna-s-suu'a, fa-dkhuluu abwaaba jahannama khaalidiina fii-haa, fa-la-bi'sa-l-matswaa-l-mutakabbiriin.**

98. **Illal-mustad'afuuna minar-rijaali wa-n-nisaa'i wa-l-wildani laa yastathii'uuna hiilata-n wa laa yah-taduuna sabiilaa.**

99. **Fa'ulaa'ika 'asa-llahu an ya'fuwa 'anhum, wa kaana-llahu 'afuwwan ghafuuraa.**

100. **Wa man yuhajir fii sabii-lillahi yajid fii-l-ardhi muraaghama-n katsiira-tan wa sa'atan, wa man yakhruj min bayti-hi muhajiran ilal-lahi wa Rasuuli-hi tsumma yudriki-hi-l-mautu faqad waqa'a ajruhu 'alallahi, wa kaana-llahu ghafuur-an rahiiman.**
